title: 第7章 绿茶与舔狗第8章 女主惨死
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
【叮！
天命主角叶不凡心中感觉屈辱无比，气运值减少20点！
【恭喜主人反派值+20！
首座之上。
红烟很是熟练地坐在姜夜身旁，而青璇则是为他沏上一杯茶，两位都是绝世佳人，颜值顶级，身材顶级，令人下方的众人艳羡不已。
茶香缥缈，宛如云烟般氤氲在空中，沁人心脾。
姜夜执起玉盏，轻轻抿了一口。
他目光缓缓扫视四周，神色平静如水，唇角却挂着一丝似笑非笑的弧度。
在场众人只感觉一股无形的压迫感施加在身，明明这位神子殿下一句话都没说，却像是一座山岳压顶般横亘在众人心头，难以喘息。
气氛死寂，压抑到极致。
甚至能听见有人紧张地吞咽口水的声音。
终于。
姜夜将目光扫向云和泰，面色淡然地开口道：“云圣主，太衍圣地往常也如今日这般热闹吗？”
云和泰瞳孔猛缩，冷汗直冒，恭敬回道：“这倒没有。”
他此刻的心情犹如坐过山车一般。
本来现在情况就已经够危险了，生怕再有丝毫得罪于姜夜的地方。
“哦？那我今天倒是想听听，什么趣事这般热闹？”
姜夜唇角微翘，语气慵懒随意，似是好奇。
云和泰哪怕半个字都不敢隐瞒，赶忙将“三年之约”
的始末一五一十尽数道出。

说完后。
姜夜静静地坐着，神情依旧平静如水，眸光深幽，看不出丝毫波澜。
可正是这份平静，让人更加不安。
在场众人全都噤若寒蝉，大气不敢出，心知这恐怕不是一个好的征兆。
姜夜沉默片刻，忽然露出一抹淡笑，随即缓缓站起。
身上的修为不再掩藏。
第八境，斩道境二重！
这一股气势如潮水般席卷开来，瞬间激起周围的波澜。
前日觉醒光明神王体后，姜夜就自然突破了。
这等气势，顿时在场中掀起一阵躁动。
云和泰与云雅曼也是愣在原地，震惊地看着眼前的姜夜，仅仅骨龄十七，竟是达到这般恐怖的修为，简直难以置信。
其他人也亦是如此反应。
还跪在一旁的叶不凡见状，眼中闪过一丝嫉妒与不甘。
他无法理解。
这个神子为何会有如此强大的修为？年龄甚至比他还要小！
“一定是依靠资源堆出来的！
content_en:
【bite!
Ye Bufan, the protagonist of Destiny, felt extremely humiliated and his luck value was reduced by 20 points!
[Congratulations to the master, the villain value is +20!
On top of the throne.
Hongyan sat next to Jiang Ye very skillfully, while Qingxuan made him a cup of tea. Both of them were extremely beautiful, with top-notch looks and top-notch figures, making everyone below them envious.
The fragrance of tea is ethereal, hanging in the air like clouds and smoke, refreshing the heart and mind.
Jiang Ye picked up the jade cup and took a sip.
His eyes slowly scanned the surroundings, his expression as calm as water, but there was a hint of a smile on the corner of his lips.
Everyone present only felt an invisible sense of oppression exerted on them. Even though His Highness the Son of God didn't say a word, he was like a mountain weighing down on everyone's minds, making it difficult to breathe.
The atmosphere was deathly silent and depressing to the extreme.
You could even hear the sound of someone swallowing nervously.
finally.
Jiang Ye glanced at Yun Hetai and said calmly: "Holy Lord Yun, is Taiyan Holy Land usually as lively as it is today?"
Yun Hetai's pupils shrank sharply, he broke out in cold sweat, and he respectfully replied: "That's not true."
His mood at the moment was like riding a roller coaster.
The current situation was already dangerous enough, and I was afraid that I might offend Jiang Ye in the slightest.
"Oh? Then I'd like to hear it today. What's the interesting story that's so exciting?"
The corners of Jiang Ye's lips were slightly raised, and his tone was lazy and casual, as if he was curious.
Yun Hetai did not dare to hide even half a word, and hurriedly wrote the "three-year agreement"
Tell the whole story from beginning to end.
After finishing speaking.
Jiang Ye sat quietly, his expression still as calm as water, his eyes were deep and there was no trace of any disturbance.
But it is this calmness that makes people even more uneasy.
Everyone present was silent and did not dare to express their anger, knowing that this was probably not a good sign.
Jiang Ye was silent for a moment, then suddenly showed a faint smile, and then slowly stood up.
The cultivation level on his body is no longer hidden.
The eighth level, the second level of Dao Dao Slaying!
This momentum swept across like a tide, instantly causing waves around it.
After awakening the Light God King's body the day before yesterday, Jiang Ye naturally made a breakthrough.
This momentum immediately caused a wave of restlessness in the venue.
Yun Hetai and Yun Yaman were also stunned on the spot, looking at Jiang Ye in shock. It was simply unbelievable that Jiang Ye, who was only seventeen years old, had reached such a terrifying cultivation level.
Others reacted the same way.
Ye Bufan, who was still kneeling aside, saw a trace of jealousy and unwillingness in his eyes.
He couldn't understand.
Why does this son of God have such a powerful cultivation level? Even younger than him!
“It must be made by relying on resources!
